- F1 manifest: the tarball for this platform (fit_lock_lookup on contracts/fixtures/garden.lock, fit_fetch, checksum verified, fit_extract) carries garden.json at its top level, and it validates against contracts/manifest.schema.json with `npx --no-install ajv validate -s contracts/manifest.schema.json -d <file> --spec=draft2020 -c ajv-formats` (node_modules are installed by setup, which also builds the stem and runs plotplot lock verify so the planted hooks find their judges in this worktree).
